phrase: Tech stocks tumbled on fears the AI spending boom cannot pay for itself. A religious leader called for AI weapons to be disarmed, calling machines tools, not people.
phraseAlternatives: Tech stocks fell to a two-month low as doubts grew about the AI spending boom. A religious leader asked the world to disarm AI weapons.
One chip maker's stock crashed and a top AI lab may get a junk credit rating. The same week, a religious leader called for AI weapons to be disarmed.
As investors lost faith in the AI spending boom, a religious leader asked for AI weapons to be laid down, calling machines tools, not people.
Markets wobbled on AI spending fears, while thousands of AI-powered 'ghost students' quietly stole millions in student loans.
alt: A thin vertical line splits the frame. On the left, a two-tier office building sits directly on a sharp, jagged, falling stock-chart line that breaks near the bottom. On the right, a calm figure in a plain grey-blue robe raises an open hand toward a small worried robot, which has just let a large blocky weapon shape drop, hanging in the air beside it, well clear of the ground.

brief.concept: A company building teeters on a cracked, plunging stock chart on one side of the frame, while on the other a calm robed figure holds up an open hand and a small robot lets a blocky weapon shape slip from its grip.
brief.metaphor: Trust in AI's money and trust in AI's conduct crack at the same time: the markets stop believing the bill will be paid, and a moral voice asks the machines to put down what they're holding.

brief.composition: Split the scene down the middle with a thin vertical line. Left half: the company building perched on a jagged, downward-sloping chart line in blue ink, the stock arrow poking through a crack near the bottom. Right half: the robed figure stands with one hand raised, palm out, facing a small robot that tilts forward, the blocky weapon shape falling from its open hand toward the ground in pink ink.
